beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:b4.title: Investment Lead
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:b4.description: Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies — niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently — accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game. RESPONSIBILITIES Deal Execution - Start to Finish At Beacon the investment process will provide you exposure to three parts of being an investor: 1. Sourcing & Selling (10%) 2. Underwriting and Execution (70%) 3. Portfolio Work (20%) The other main functions of the role include: - Building and scaling our proprietary M&A agents and AI product suite - Collaborate with Beacon’s Investment Directors, executive team and value creation team to evaluate and close acquisitions. - Lead and manage conversations and relationships with owners, advisors, and bankers. - Prepare and analyze financial and non-financial information, valuation, and operational models. - Drive the entire M&A process, including conducting detailed financial, sales, marketing, and operational diligence; drafting investment memorandums for the Investment Committee and crafting the integration strategy. - Manage diligence processes and engage with internal/external advisors across legal, technology, HR, and tax. - Assist in the finance, operations, and integration of newly acquired businesses. QUALIFICATIONS - Strong academic record from a competitive institution with a degree in Business or Finance. - A strong understanding of technology and a passion for the software industry. - Minimum 1-6 years of M&A experience, working in private equity, investment banking, consulting, corporate development, or strategic finance. - Familiarity with a buy-and-build model and experience/knowledge in VMS, software, and technology is a plus. - Expertise in building financial models, and proficiency in preparing thoughtfully structured analysis. - Strong ability to synthesize complex systems. - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to be able to interact with stakeholders at all levels of the Company and targets. - Ability to translate high level objectives into actionable work plans and strategies. - High attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines. - Extremely organized. - Conduct interactions with a high level of integrity and trust. - Advanced written and verbal communication skills. - Demonstrated interest in learning about different businesses across diverse industries. - Possesses a growth mindset, consistently seeking personal and process improvement. - Strong interpersonal skills to build and maintain genuine, long-term relationships. WHAT YOU WILL GET FROM BEACON - Demonstrated interest in learning about different businesses across diverse industries. - Learn directly from entrepreneurs who have scaled businesses from seed-to-$10B+ IPOs. - Work directly with Silicon Valley product

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7a397674-a19f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr Principal HR Business Partner based in United States. This is a senior-level HR leadership opportunity supporting multiple functional organizations within a complex, highly matrixed environment. The role serves as a strategic advisor to senior executives, connecting business priorities with workforce and talent strategies. You will influence decisions across workforce planning, succession, leadership effectiveness, employee engagement, and organizational change. The position combines strategic consulting with hands-on guidance on complex employee relations and organizational matters. You will use workforce and business data to identify trends, assess organizational health, and shape actionable people strategies. jobgether-jobgether:lever:bf0421ec-2ee2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Partner Sales Manager, Microsoft based in the United States. The Partner Sales Manager will play a key role in accelerating growth through a strategic Microsoft partnership. This position focuses on executing global co-sell programs, joint go-to-market initiatives, and partner-led sales motions that generate measurable pipeline and revenue. You will work closely with Microsoft sales, marketing, and partner organizations while coordinating internal teams to turn strategic priorities into effective field execution. The role combines relationship management, sales operations, program management, and commercial strategy in a highly collaborative environment. You will help expand marketplace presence, optimize partner programs, and activate opportunities involving Azure, Microsoft 365, AI, and Copilot. Success will depend on your ability to build senior relationships, manage multiple workstreams, and translate complex partnership priorities into repeatable commercial outcomes. This is an opportunity for an experienced alliance professional to influence a high-impact technology partnership across a global, enterprise-focused market. Execute the global co-sell strategy across the product portfolio, translating partnership priorities into actionable sales programs and field initiatives. Develop and execute joint sales plays with Microsoft's Enterprise, SME&C, and Global Partner Solutions organizations to increase pipeline generation and customer acquisition. Expand marketplace presence and help structure enterprise engagements to align with Microsoft Azure Consumption Commitments and related commercial objectives. Maximize participation in relevant Microsoft partner programs, incentives, and co-investment opportunities, including MAICPP, ECIF, and Frontier Acceleration. Deliver joint enablement and training programs for internal and Microsoft teams to strengthen product knowledge, sales alignment, and co-sell execution. Build and maintain senior-level relationships across Microsoft's sales and marketing organizations and position the business as a preferred co-sell partner. Represent the organization at Microsoft events, customer meetings, partner forums, and industry engagements worldwide. Translate strategic Microsoft priorities, including AI and Microsoft Copilot initiatives, into practical joint go-to-market motions. Define, monitor, and report key partnership performance indicators, including Microsoft-influenced revenue, co-sell pipeline, marketplace-transacted revenue, and partner-sourced leads. Support quarterly business reviews and leadership updates by providing performance insights, progress summaries, and recommendations. Establish standardized processes for Microsoft engagement and recommend improvements that increase efficiency, visibility, consistency, and scalability. Coordinate multiple internal and external stakeholders to ensure partnership initiatives are tracked effectively and deliver measurable commercial outcomes. Requirements: 8+ years of experience in cloud, SaaS, or enterprise technology, including at least 3 years in a Microsoft alliance, partner, or co-sell leadership role. Deep, current understanding of Microsoft's field coverage model and decision-making processes within SME&C and Enterprise organizations. Working knowledge of the Microsoft commercial marketplace, Azure Consumption Commitment (MACC) mechanics, MAICPP, Frontier Acceleration, and ECIF. Demonstrated success building and scaling partner-led and co-sell motions that generate repeatable, measurable revenue at enterprise scale. Proven history of meeting or exceeding revenue and pipeline targets in complex, multi-region environments. Strong familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365/O365, and Microsoft's AI and Copilot ecosystem. Experience using CRM and pipeline management tools such as Salesforce and Microsoft

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:65f8610d-e1ba-4bdc.title: Motion designer
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:65f8610d-e1ba-4bdc.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми розширюємо команду маркетингу і знаходимося в пошуках Motion Designer. У тебе буде можливість працювати разом з досвідченою командою, обмінюватися експертизою і швидко зростати. Отже, ця можливість говорить сама за себе. Ключова зона відповідальності: — Ideation: генерація візуальної складової креатива на основі технічних задач команди маркетингу; — Production: розробка відео-креативів для просування продукту у рекламних мережах (Facebook, Tik-Tok, YouTube); — Cooperation: тісна співпраця з маркетинговим відділом і обговорення ідей щодо покращення роботи існуючих креативів; — Experiments: тестування нових інструментів, ефектів, плагінів, створення шаблонів проєктів для більш ефективної роботи; — Creative research: аналіз рекламних матеріалів конкурентів та соціальних мереж для відстеження світових тенденцій у дизайні; — Analytics: Аналіз креативів та побудова гіпотез на основі їх результатів. Наші очікування від кандидатів: — Комерційний досвід — до 1 року; — Практичні знання After Effects (2 роки), Photoshop (2 роки), Illustrator(1 рік), Figma(1 рік), плюсом буде знання Blender та Cinema 4D; — Практичний досвід з монтажу відео, плюсом буде знання Premiere Pro; — Практичні знання AI (Midjourney https://www.imagine.art/, Elevenlabs, RunWay, Remini, HeyGen, Sora, PixVerse) та подібні; — Практичне застосування плагінів (Motion Bro, Trapcode Suite, Animation Composer) та подібні; — Знання основних принципів дизайну, композиції і колористики; — Високий рівень креативності та здатність генерувати ідеї, які відповідають потребам користувачів та бізнес-вимогам; — Гарні комунікативні навички, здатність швидко налагоджувати контакт з колегами всередині команди та поза межами проєкту; — Грамотна оцінка часу та ресурсів, необхідних для виконання завдань, навички самостійного тайм-менеджменту. Тобі точно до нас, якщо ти: — Умієш аргументовано відстоювати свою думку та самостійно приймати рішення; — Не боїшся швидкого темпу роботи й великої кількості експериментів; — Вмієш планувати свою завантаження і працювати з дедлайнами; — Чуєш фідбек і прагнеш до швидкого професійного зростання і саморозвитку; — Не боїшся швидкого темпу роботи й готовий брати на себе відповідальність за результат. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: — SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. — Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. — Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо. — Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі со

southparkcommons-simular:ashbyhq:bc7c570.title: Software Engineer, Monetization Platform
southparkcommons-simular:ashbyhq:bc7c570.description: Where multiple locations are listed for this role, the position may be based in any of those locations, with priority determined according to the order of listing. At Simular, we are building AI agents that operate computers to help people and businesses get work done. As our product reaches more customers, we need the commercial systems that make product access, pricing, and revenue reliable. You will build the backend foundation that turns customer accounts and product usage into clear plans, accurate bills, successful payments, and correctly provisioned access. This is a SaaS monetization role focused on accounts, subscriptions, billing, payments, and entitlements. It is not an ads monetization role, and it is not primarily a cloud infrastructure or agent-runtime role. What you'll do - Own the domain models and APIs for customer accounts, organizations, workspaces, plans, pricing, trials, seats, and entitlements - Build subscription and usage-based billing systems, including metering, aggregation, invoicing, credits, proration, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and recovery flows - Integrate Stripe and future payment providers across checkout, recurring payments, payment failures, refunds, disputes, and provider webhooks - Design robust payment and billing state machines that are idempotent, replay-safe, observable, and resilient to duplicate, delayed, or out-of-order events - Build trustworthy financial records, reconciliation workflows, audit trails, and internal tools for resolving account and billing exceptions - Partner with product and customer-facing teams to translate commercial requirements into simple, maintainable systems and customer experiences - Set a high bar for correctness and operational ownership in systems where a wrong charge or missing entitlement directly affects customer trust You might be a fit if - You have a BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience and 5+ years of backend engineering experience - You have built production systems for B2B SaaS, e-commerce, fintech, or another transaction-heavy product - You have hands-on experience with Stripe or a comparable payment provider, including webhooks, payment lifecycle events, and failure handling - You can model complex business domains such as accounts, subscriptions, orders, invoices, payments, usage, and entitlements - You understand idempotency, transactional consistency, money precision, reconciliation, auditing, and safe data migration practices - You are strong with relational databases and production API design, and you can reason clearly about correctness under retries and partial failures - You have a bias for action, communicate clearly, and enjoy owning an ambiguous 0 to 1 domain end-to-end - Bonus: experience with usage-based billing, revenue operations, tax or invoicing systems, multi-currency payments, or financial ledgers
